rows.notes: Male; Nyan-Nyan invitation, early in the route.

rows.en: I'm really sorry. Next time, for sure...
rows.notes: x32, both genders, all early refusals.

rows.en:
(Oh, there's Yuu. Perfect timing.
I'll go ask her.)

Oh, \p-chan?
What is it?
rows.notes: x16, female; twin of c11876 ('Oh, \p-kun?\nWhat is it?').

rows.en:
Huh?! Me?
I'm sorry... Um... well...

Huh? The Observation Pier...
You mean THAT Observation Pier, right...?
Hmm... that's a little...
rows.notes: x4, both genders; she hints the pier is a date spot.

rows.en:
The Macross Quarter...
Hmm... I don't know about that...

Shopping at Folmo... That sounds nice!
Oh, but this weekend, I think I...
rows.notes: x4, both genders; trails off as in the Japanese.

rows.en:
"199," huh...? That sounds nice!
Oh, but this weekend, I think I...

The artificial island...
In that case... hmm... that's a little...
rows.notes: x4, both genders; glossary lowercase 'the artificial island'.

rows.en:
Central Park... Let me see...
Oh, but this weekend, I think I...

The Battle Frontier...
Hmm... I don't know about that...

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll ask Akimizu to stop off somewhere
with me on the way home...)
rows.notes: x6, male; same shape as c04157.

rows.en:
Hey, Akimizu. You wanna stop off somewhere
on the way home?

Oh, \p-kun.
Stop off somewhere... That's not a bad idea!
...Huh?!

Um... I've got something to do after this...
I'm really sorry. Ask me again, okay?

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll ask Yuu to stop off somewhere
with me on the way home...)

Hey, Yuu. You wanna stop off somewhere
on the way home?

Oh, \p-chan.
Stop off somewhere... That's not a bad idea!
...Huh?!

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Akimizu to Griffith Park
and just take it easy...)

Oh, \p-kun.
What's up?

Um, I've got other plans this weekend...
I'm really sorry! Next time for sure!

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Yuu to Griffith Park
and just take it easy...)

Oh, \p-chan.
What's up?

Griffith Park... That might be nice!
...Oh!?
rows.notes: x2, female scene (the male scene uses c11901).

rows.en:
(This weekend, maybe I'll invite Akimizu
to go shopping in Deep Akihabara.)

Deep Akihabara... That sounds fun!
...Oh!?

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Yuu to go shopping
in Deep Akihabara...)

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Akimizu to Nyan-Nyan
or something...)

Nyan-Nyan... That's really tempting!
...Oh!?

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Yuu to Nyan-Nyan
or something...)

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe Akimizu and I could go see a concert
at the Sky Gate.)

A concert... That might be nice!
...Oh!?

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe Yuu and I could go see a concert
at the Sky Gate.)

Yeah, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
a concert at the Sky Gate with me this weekend...

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe Akimizu and I could go to
the Shibuya Area or something...)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go
shopping in the Shibuya Area with me
this weekend...

Um... well... I'm sorry...
I really, really want to go, but
I haven't been in the mood lately...
rows.notes: x4, both genders; hints at something bothering her.

rows.en: I see. Well, it can't be helped, then...
I'm really sorry...
No, it's fine. Don't worry about it!
(I wonder if something's up with Akimizu...)

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe Yuu and I could go to
the Shibuya Area or something...)

Yeah, I was wondering if you'd want to go
shopping in the Shibuya Area with me
this weekend...
I see. Well, it can't be helped, then...
It's fine. Don't worry about it!
(I wonder if something's up with Yuu...)

(When it comes to summer...
Hmm, how should I spend it...)

Hey, \p.
What are you doing out here?

Just trying to figure out what to do
to really enjoy the summer...

Enjoy the summer, huh... Wouldn't that be
the beach or something?
Well, that's the summer classic, sure.

Other than that... fireworks, yukata,
watermelon splitting... festivals, that's
about it. They all sound like fun.
rows.notes: x2, Alto, both genders; Japanese breaks inside 'festivals / that's about it', English keeps the list whole.

rows.en: ...Alto, you'd look good in all of those.
Yeah, I get that a lot...

(Him in a women's yukata, like back in
his kabuki days... No, let's not go there...)
rows.notes: Male; 'onnagata de yukata' = in a yukata as a female-role actor.

rows.en:
(When it comes to summer...
Hmm, how should I spend it~...)

Just trying to figure out what to do
to really enjoy the summer~...
Well, that's the summer classic, sure.
...Saotome-kun, you'd look good in all of those.

(Him in a women's yukata, like back in
his kabuki days... He'd look sooo good...)

uncertain: c15513: 'ano tenbou sanbashi' read as the pier being known as a date spot ('THAT Observation Pier'); caps used for stress since the font has no italics.
c15561/c15567: 'sore minna niaisou' taken as the player teasing Alto that the summer things (yukata, festivals) would suit his looks; Alto's 'I get that a lot' supports it.
c15563/c15568: onnagata (female-role kabuki actor) rendered 'in a women's yukata, like back in his kabuki days' rather than the bare term, as earlier slices used 'female roles'.
